interpretation: Useful original decisions and transparent evidence; no word-count or keyword-density rule.
Research summaries must not pretend to be first-party tested reviews.
No uncontrolled generated matrix, misleading authorship, hidden text or fake activity.
Ordinary crawlable links, HTML content, status codes and accessible rendering.
Important content and indexing controls should not depend only on later client execution.
Canonicalization reflects exact identities and equivalent pages; it is neither a crawl block nor a universal duplicate penalty.
Bound state and filter discovery. Query-state noindex does not prevent crawling.
Sitemaps contain intended canonical indexable URLs. Submission and recrawl requests do not guarantee indexing.
Use descriptive anchors. Qualify commercial/user links appropriately, ordinary citations remain normal.
Descriptive accurate titles and summaries, no automatic year suffix or fixed ranking length target.
Product information without an eligible offer/review is not a promise of a product rich result. No invented ratings, stock or direct-merchant status.
FAQ rich-result support ended May 7, 2026. Do not add retired FAQ/HowTo promises. October 1 generative-AI content guidance update inspected.
